title: Tokyo Wild Encounters
logline: Walking through neon Tokyo, every stranger turns the street into a surreal confrontation.

0.prompt:
First-person POV. The camera is the hero's eyes. One continuous handheld take, walking pace, natural body sway.

Photoreal Akihabara, Tokyo, neon-lit night. Animated billboards, glowing maid-cafe awnings, crowded arcades, and capsule-toy machines.

[0 to 3 seconds] Looking forward as the hero walks along the packed sidewalk beneath pulsing signs. The hero's hands swing at the bottom of frame. Pedestrians part around a tiny wrestling ring painted across the pavement.

[3 to 7 seconds] Walk toward the street ring. A cheerful maid-cafe girl in a black-and-white frilled dress raises a pink foam mallet inside it. A muscular yakuza in a burgundy suit rolls up his sleeves beside her. A silver-haired catgirl referee in a striped shirt and furry cat ears bounds between them, then looks straight into the lens. The hero's hands rise at the bottom of frame.

[7 to 10 seconds] The silver-haired catgirl referee presents two glowing arcade buttons, pink beneath the maid-cafe girl and red beneath the yakuza. She points both paw-gloved hands at them and says, "Choose your challenger." The maid-cafe girl and the yakuza lean toward the camera, staring into the lens. End on that beat.

Audio: Catgirl referee, close and clear: "Choose your challenger." Arcade jingles, pedestrian chatter, distant traffic, neon transformer hum, shoes on pavement, foam mallet squeak.
